question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '**farmers**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the historical context of silk production and the cultivation of mulberry trees to feed silkworm larvae.
 
• The appropriate noun should describe individuals responsible for agricultural activities such as planting trees, which aligns with the role of "farmers."
 
• "**Farmers**" fits well as it denotes people engaged in growing crops and trees, as required for the production of silk.
 
• Other options ("**nurses**", "**teachers**", "**soldiers**") do not fit the context of agricultural tasks described in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nurses:** While "nurses" care for living beings, they are not associated with planting or agricultural activities.
 
• **Teachers: **"Teachers" impart knowledge and are unrelated to the context of tree planting or silkworm rearing.
 
• **Soldiers:** "Soldiers" are involved in defense and military activities, which do not fit the context of agricultural work in silk production.
